title: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Ltd.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:OTHER (92 affected)
summary: THE LOWER STEERING COLUMN LINKAGE HEAT SHIELD CAN COME IN CONTACT WITH A BRAKE HYDRAULIC SYSTEM PIPE MOUNTED TO THE ENGINE ASSEMBLY, EVENTUALLY RESULTING IN A HYDRAULIC FLUID LEAK.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: BMW/EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (5,200 affected)
summary: AN OVERSTATEMENT WAS MADE OF THE VEHICLE LOAD CAPACITY AND DESIGNATED SEATING CAPACITY ON THE TIRE INFORMATION PLACARD. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 110, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS."

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER:BAL (27,604 affected)
summary: THE SPHERICAL PORTIONS OF CERTAIN LOWER BALL JOINTS HAD FINISHED SURFACES THAT WERE NOT SMOOTH CAUSING FRICTION WITH THE SURFACE OF THE BALL JOINT CAP.

title: Ducati North America: EQUIPMENT:MOTORCYCLE KICKSTAND (600 affected)
summary: THE SIDE STAND SPRING PLATE ON THE RETRACTABLE SIDE STAND CAN BREAK ALLOWING THE SIDE STAND TO DROP AND POSSIBLY HIT THE GROUND WHILE THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (18,500 affected)
summary: AIR SYSTEM BLOCKAGE IN THE AIR DRYER OCCURS DEGRADING THE MOISTURE REMOVING CAPABILITIES OF THE DRYER WHEN THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN A COLD ENVIRONMENT AND MOISTURE ACCUMULATES AND FREEZES IN THE AIR DRYER OR IN THE LINE BETWEEN THE DRYER AND THE AIR SYSTEM RESERVOIR. THE AIR DRYER CAN BECOME OVER PRESSURIZED CAUSING THE AIR DRYER CARTRIDGE TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING BASE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACKS AND ANCHORS (48 affected)
summary: DURING TESTING OF FMVSS NO. 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS," THE SEAT BASE DEFORMS ALLOWING THE SEAT BACK ANCHORAGES TO DETACH FROM THE FLOOR.  THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 207.

title: HPA MONON TRAILER, INC.: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES AND FITTINGS (3,109 affected)
summary: THE AIR LINE CONNECTIONS WERE INCORRECTLY INSTALLED ON THESE TRAILERS CAUSING THE AIR BRAKE APPLICATION AND RELEASE TIMES TO BE SLOWER THAN REQUIRED BY FMVSS NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: ARVINMERITOR AUTOMOTIVE: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:END (1,386 affected)
summary: DURING ASSEMBLY, THE TIE ROD END NUTS WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED. EXTREMELY LOW TORQUE CAN ALLOW  MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE BALL STUD AND THE TIE ROD ARM CAUSING DAMAGE.

title: Kia America, Inc.: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR (1,319 affected)
summary: THE NUTS ATTACHING THE REAR AXLE BEARING OIL SEAL RETAINERS AND BRAKE BACKING PLATES TO THE REAR AXLE HOUSING MAY BE UNDER- TORQUED CAUSING THESE UNITS TO LOOSEN OR FALL OFF.

title: ALLIEDSIGNAL INC.: ENGINE:OIL FILTER/BRACKET (25,115 affected)
summary: THE DISTANCE FROM THE FIRST THREAD OF THE FILTER TO THE GASKET FACE IS APPROXIMATELY 0.405" AND IT SHOULD BE APPROXIMATELY 0.388". THIS DESIGN ONLY ALLOWS A FEW THREADS TO ENGAGE WHEN INSTALLING ON MOTORCYCLE AND CAN RESULT IN THE FILTER "BLOWING OFF."

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART (365 affected)
summary: THE WIRING TO THE BREAKAWAY SWITCH LOCATED ON THE PARK TRAILER A-FRAME WAS INCORRECTLY INSTALLED. THIS SWITCH ACTIVATES THE TRAILER BRAKES IF THE PARK TRAILER BECOMES DISCONNECTED FROM THE TOW VEHICLE DURING TOWING.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:END (300 affected)
summary: DURING ASSEMBLY, THE TIE ROD END NUTS WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED. EXTREMELY LOW TORQUE CAN ALLOW MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE BALL STUD AND THE TIE ROD ARM CAUSING DAMAGE.

title: SGM COMPANY, INC.: HEATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER AND VENTILATION (241 affected)
summary: THE PLASTIC HOUSING ON THESE UNITS CAN CRACK AND FALL ONTO A MOTOR RESISTOR.

title: GIBSON CHEMICAL AND OIL: BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG (1,957 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE FLUID FAILED TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 116, "MOTOR VEHICLE BRAKE FLUIDS," AND IS BELIEVED TO BE CONTAMINATED.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (250 affected)
summary: THE WOODEN CONVENIENCE TABLE LOCATED IN THE LIVING ROOM AREA OF THE MOTORHOME WAS NOT SECURELY ATTACHED TO THE FLOOR ALLOWING MOVEMENT DURING VEHICLE TRANSIT.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: COMMUNICATIONS:HORN ASSEMBLY (211 affected)
summary: THE INTERNATIONAL HORN EMBLEM IS MISSING FROM THE LEATHER STEERING WHEEL COVER. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS FOR FMVSS NO. 101, "CONTROLS AND DISPLAYS."

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM UPPER:BAL (271 affected)
summary: THE UPPER BALL JOINT NUTS WERE UNDER-TORQUED RESULTING IN IMPROPER SEATING IN THE STEERING KNUCKLE.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:REAR (8,323 affected)
summary: VEHICLES FAIL TO CONFORM TO FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ANCHORAGES." THE CENTER REAR SEAT LAP BELT WAS IMPROPERLY ROUTED.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING (87,039 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES FAIL TO CONFORM TO FMVSS NO. 124, "ACCELERATOR CONTROL SYSTEMS." AT LOW TEMPERATURES, EXCESSIVE FRICTION CAN OCCUR IN THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL ASSEMBLY.

title: BUELL-out of business: WHEELS:RIM BASE (651 affected)
summary: MOTORCYCLES DO NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS."  THE RIMS DO NOT CONTAIN THE REQUIRED DESIGNATION INFORMATION.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (4,709 affected)
summary: AIR SYSTEM BLOCKAGE IN THE AIR DRYER OCCURS DEGRADING THE MOISTURE REMOVING CAPABILITIES OF THE DRYER  WHEN THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN A COLD ENVIRONMENT AND MOISTURE ACCUMULATES AND FREEZES IN THE AIR DRYER OR IN THE LINE BETWEEN THE DRYER AND THE AIR SYSTEM RESERVOIR. THE AIR DRYER CAN BECOME OVERPRESSURIZED CAUSING THE AIR DRYER CARTRIDGE TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING BASE.

title: ALL OUR KIDS JUVENILE PRO: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT: INDEPENDENT (25,482 affected)
summary: THE NYLON FABRIC IN THESE CHILD SAFETY RESTRAINTS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS" AND FMVSS NO. 302, "FLAMMABILITY OF INTERIOR MATERIALS."
